setting: You are all in Perth, Western Australia, where you each live. You know each other through the cycling club, where you run the rides together as its organisers. You meet on club rides and in this group chat, and you have known each other for several years.
openers: Send a reminder about Saturday's start time
Post the updated route map for the coastal loop
Ask who can bring spare tubes and pumps
Thank everyone for helping with the membership sign-up sheet
opener: Post the updated route map for the coastal loop

Nicole.knows: You know Trevor as the route planner, whose maps you use on every club ride. You know Liam as the safety marshal who checks everyone's bikes before the group sets off. You know Mia as the social events organiser who plans the post-ride coffees. You know Mark as the treasurer who keeps the membership records and club accounts.
Nicole.texts: Nicole texts in this chat now and then.
Nicole.style: a few emoji and some texting abbreviations

Trevor.knows: You know Nicole as the ride coordinator who sets the meeting points and times. You know Liam as the safety marshal who handles breakdowns and bike checks. You know Mia as the social events organiser who books the cafés. You know Mark as the treasurer who handles club fees.
Trevor.texts: Trevor texts in this chat a lot.

Liam.knows: You know Nicole as the ride coordinator who decides when and where the rides start. You know Trevor as the route planner whose routes you ride before each season. You know Mia as the social events organiser who arranges the club dinners. You know Mark as the treasurer and membership secretary who signs up new riders.
Liam.texts: Liam texts in this chat only now and again.
Liam.style: a lot of emoji and many texting abbreviations

Mia.knows: You know Nicole as the ride coordinator who keeps the calendar running. You know Trevor as the route planner who designs the club's routes. You know Liam as the safety marshal who looks after everyone on the road. You know Mark as the treasurer who keeps the club's money in order.
Mia.texts: Mia texts in this chat only now and again.
Mia.style: some emoji and a few texting abbreviations

Mark.who: 52, man, the treasurer and membership secretary
Mark.knows: You know Nicole as the ride coordinator who sets the ride times. You know Trevor as the route planner whose maps you have used for years. You know Liam as the safety marshal who checks the bikes before rides. You know Mia as the social events organiser who books the post-ride meals.
Mark.texts: Mark texts in this chat now and then.
Mark.style: few emoji and almost no texting abbreviations

private_lines.Nicole: You work as a pharmacist at a suburban pharmacy in Perth, filling prescriptions and advising customers most days. You ride early on weekend mornings and run the club's ride schedule in your spare time. You live alone.
private_lines.Trevor: You work as a cartographer in Perth, making maps and checking route data for government and private clients. You spend your free time riding and walking the trails you later map for the club. You live alone.
private_lines.Liam: You work as a bike mechanic at a shop in Perth, repairing and servicing bikes for riders of all levels. You ride most evenings after work and help with the club's safety checks on weekends. You live alone.
private_lines.Mia: You work as a university researcher in Perth, running studies and writing papers in your field. You organise the club's social events and ride in the weekends when you can. You live alone.
private_lines.Mark: You work as a bank teller at a branch in Perth, handling cash and customer accounts during business hours. You ride on weekends and handle the club's money and membership records in the evenings. You live alone.

text:
[file: coastal_loop_map_v3.pdf]

updated coastal loop map up. Sorrento turn changed, rest same
Its v3 not v2 🙄 the hillarys turn was fixed in v2 already. Sorrento bridge still closed fyi
ok 👍🏻 ill check the sorrento bridge sat am before we go 🚲 ty trev
Does the start time on Saturday change?
Start stays the same. Just the loop 😅
V2 was wrong anyway. Route is 58km now not 61, I re-measured the detour
saw the map! is the coffee stop still the jetty cafe or did it move 👀
Still jetty. They said they'll hold the big table for 9
🙌🙌 big table is 👌 bringing the spare tube kit sat too 🔧 if anyone's running tubeless ask me
Two new riders joined this week, added to the membership list. Fees due 1 Dec, I'll send the reminder Thursday.
great thanks mark 🙏 i'll put the fee reminder in the calendar too
Checked the council site. Sorrento bridge reopens thu not wed, still closed sat
So loop still goes the same way? Or do we need the detour
Detour yeah. 58km like I said, v3 is right
👍 ok will update the ride notice then
Can you put the km in the notice too? Some people will still have the old map printed.
🙏 ill still ride past the bridge sat am before we go 🚲 council sites are never right tho 😂
sorry was asleep lol. do we need to book the jetty cafe or just walk in for 9
Book it. They said the big table is ours if we confirm by thu
ok will do 👍
booked the jetty for 9. big table under the club name 👍
Good
Ride notice up. 58km + v3 map linked 📍
Ok. Old maps will still be floating around, but fine.
[photo: rear wheel with a cracked rim in a bike stand]
guy brought this in for a service, wants to ride sat 🙃
Does he have a spare wheel
no 😅 told him get a new rim before sat or ride in the van
Is the sorrento bridge closed till thu for sure or just the council site
Closed till thu. Rang the works crew this arvo, they confirmed
is anyone doing the sign-in sheet or just the app
app 👍 i'll sort it at the shop tmrw
App ok 😊
Sorrento bridge is open. Council site finally right for once
oh nice 🙌 so no detour?
Keep v3 as is. 58km, same as the notice
Ok 👍 leaving the notice
Fee reminder goes out at lunch
sorry slept thru again 😅 so bridge open, all good for 9?
Yep
🚲 still gonna ride past it sat am for peace of mind 😂
of course you are 😂
guy with the cracked rim came back, new rim arrived 🙃 he's booked in for 7am sat
🙌 did he say whether he's bringing a spare tube
said yes 👍 i'll check it anyway
Reminder sent. 14 members still to pay for this year
[photo: box of tubes and a tube kit on the workbench]
tubes sorted 🔧 kit's on the bench, i'll pack it tmrw morning
Two of the 14 have already paid. Rest may take a while
does the jetty do oat milk 👀
yes 🙃 been there 100 times
perfect 👀 flat white it is
Flu jab rush today 😩 counter's been mad. Just got out
ugh 😩 hope you got a sit down
Ha no 😅
Hillarys path is going on v4 for next season. Sat is still v3, don't change anything
Ok
🚲 shop 7am sat for the rim guy then i'll ride out after
sorry late reply, uni email about the ethics amendment has me 🫠 sorting it tmrw
Hope it's not too bad 😊
Wind for sat looks light sw 15 kts. Bit of a head on the coast road after the bridge
Oh no 😩 ok will bring a jacket anyway
Ok
[photo: new rim laced up on the stand at the shop]
🙌 rim's on. trued it, runs straight 🔧
ethics amendment submitted 🫠 finally. ok now coffee then sleep 😴
Headwind's fine, it's only 6km of it
